title: Rust lichen-link: implement selected relay signer key-selection
description: Align rust/lichen-link with the selected option. PENDING project-LICHEN-worker6-nxew. Current: relay_verified_frame (relay.rs:83) re-signs with own key/SIID/counter and RX resolves keys via SIID-indexed peer map (link_layer.rs:1117 peers.get(&signer_iid)). If option (b): mostly normative conformance tests + TOFU cache-semantics hardening (pin/evict/reject-mismatch) to match updated spec; if option (a): transcript/frame changes in frame.rs + schnorr.rs; if option (c): chain verification + relay.rs rewrite. Acceptance: cargo clippy --all-features -D warnings and cargo test for lichen-link pass; conformance tests encode the decided policy; no_std feature build clean.
close_reason: Option (b) confirmed ratified (nxew CLOSED: SIID-indexed TOFU, no wire change; spec/02 4.2 normative text present via closed child 1zh2). Audit of rust/lichen-link against spec/02 4.2 paragraphs 1-5 found the implementation ALREADY fail-closed-conformant: indexed-only key resolution (link_layer.rs:1117 peers.get(&signer_iid), canonical-EUI check :1128, verify under that key only, no trial-verify fallback), pin-on-first-verified-contact after verify+replay (:1175), pin-mismatch -> KeyChange before any replay advance (:1145-1155), LRU eviction drops pin AND resets replay (:957-960), explicit evict paths remove_peer/forget_peer reset replay. unpin_peer deliberately retains the replay window (tested security decision replay_rejected_after_unpin_does_not_reauthenticate_peer :1600) - mapped to spec 4.2 p5 as non-eviction (trust entry retained); flagged for cross-validation bead p3kv. Added conformance: tests/tofu_key_selection.rs (5 tests) - pin-on-first-verified-contact; substitution attack with VALID foreign signature over victim-SIID transcript rejected fail-closed (pin+replay untouched, victim's genuine next frame accepted); no-trial-verification-fallback with attacker also provisioned; relay re-sign byte-exact vs independent PyNaCl oracles in test/vectors/wire_format_v2.json (wf2_hop_resign_inputs: relay seed 0x01*32, own SIID 3784728ae7309eab, own counter 6/200, == wf2 encoded bytes); wf2_announce_epoch_replay_hop_resigned link-half accepts fresh relay counter 7/55, sender binds relay key, duplicate rejected Replay. In-cage test lru_eviction_drops_pin_and_invalidates_replay (spec 4.2 p5). No src behavior change needed - tests only (41-line append). Gates: cargo test -p lichen-link --features std,schnorr = 202 passed / 0 failed (156 lib, 46 integration); cargo clippy -p lichen-link --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --check clean; cargo check -p lichen-link (no_std default) clean. Commit bdc732ec6a. lichen-rpl untouched. Filed P3: dangling 4.6 cross-reference in spec/02 4.2.
